title: ctenopteris kegeliana
intro: Ctenopteris kegeliana, commonly known as the New Zealand tree fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in relieving conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ctenopteris kegeliana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that exhibit immunomodulatory, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti-cancer activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the mechanisms and potential applications of this plant species.
